senses.en: related to medicine or treatment

ex.en: She hopes to do medical work in a village.
ex.zh: 她希望在乡村做医疗工作。

ex.en: Medical care that exists only in the city leaves village families travelling for hours.
ex.zh: 只存在于城市的医疗，会让乡村家庭赶几小时的路。

tip: medical 是形容词；medicine 是名词“药”或“医学”。

senses.en: a person who prepares text for publication

ex.en: The editor checked every name.
ex.zh: 编辑核对了每一个名字。

ex.en: A school editor who fixes a wrong score before printing saves a week of apology.
ex.zh: 在付印前改掉错误分数的校刊编辑，能省下一周的道歉。

tip: edition 是版本，已在本库。editor 是做这件事的人。

senses.en: a time when something happens later than planned
to make something later

ex.en: The delay was twenty minutes.
ex.zh: 延误了二十分钟。

ex.en: A delay should be written on the notice before parents leave work.
ex.zh: 延误应当在家长下班之前写到通知上。

tip: delay 作动词是推迟。

senses.en: the freedom to do what you want, within the law

ex.en: The text discusses liberty and also the bus.
ex.zh: 课文讨论自由，也讨论公交。

ex.en: Liberty to speak still has a limit: no one may threaten a classmate.
ex.zh: 说话的自由仍有界限：谁也不能威胁同学。

tip: freedom 已在本库，更常用。liberty 更正式。

senses.en: to rest on a chair or the ground

ex.en: Please sit near the window if you need light.
ex.zh: 如果你需要光线，请坐在靠窗的地方。

ex.en: Students who sit in the same seat all term may never meet the classmates behind them.
ex.zh: 整个学期都坐同一座位的学生，可能始终认识不到身后的同学。

tip: sit 的过去式和过去分词都是 sat。坐下常用 sit down。

senses.en: a feeling of pleasure in what you or others have done

ex.en: She spoke with pride about the class garden.
ex.zh: 她自豪地谈起班级的园子。

ex.en: Pride in a score should still name who watered the garden.
ex.zh: 为分数自豪时，仍然应当说出是谁给园子浇的水。

tip: 形容词 proud 已在本库。take pride in doing。

senses.en: to go from one side to the other
a mark or a place where things meet
angry

ex.en: Cross the road at the lights.
ex.zh: 在红绿灯处过马路。

ex.en: Children cross a busy road more safely when the light gives them enough time.
ex.zh: 当信号灯给足时间时，孩子过繁忙的马路会更安全。

tip: cross 是动词；across 是介词。

senses.en: a soft hat, or a cover

ex.en: He left his cap on the chair.
ex.zh: 他把帽子落在椅子上了。

ex.en: A bottle cap that is loose in the lab is a reason to stop.
ex.zh: 实验室里松了的瓶盖是停下来的理由。

tip: cap 多指无檐或只有前面有檐的帽子。hat 通常更有边，本批另有词条。

senses.en: a sudden serious event causing harm
Something that goes extremely badly or fails completely.

ex.en: An earthquake is a natural disaster.
ex.zh: 地震是一种自然灾害。

ex.en: Effective early warning systems can reduce the damage caused by natural disasters and help communities recover more quickly.
ex.zh: 有效的预警系统可以减少自然灾害造成的损失，并帮助社区更快恢复。

tip: 也可夸张形容失败：The party was a disaster。

senses.en: a period in a process, or a platform for performers

ex.en: We are at the first stage of the project.
ex.zh: 我们处在项目的第一阶段。

ex.en: The stage of a plan that nobody checks is often the one that fails in the rain.
ex.zh: 计划中没人检查的那个阶段，往往是在雨里失败的阶段。

tip: stage 作动词是“上演”。

senses.en: a place to sit
to give someone a place to sit, or to have room for

ex.en: Is this seat free?
ex.zh: 这个座位有人吗？

ex.en: A reserved seat on the bus matters for a student who cannot stand the whole way.
ex.zh: 公交上的预留座位，对不能全程站着的学生很重要。

tip: seat 作动词是“使就座”，如 seat 30 people。

senses.en: towards the front

ex.en: Please step forward when your name is called.
ex.zh: 叫到你的名字时请向前走。

ex.en: Looking forward without asking residents can put a new road through the only playground.
ex.zh: 不询问居民就向前规划，可能会让新路穿过唯一的操场。

tip: look forward to 后接名词或 doing。

senses.en: a small container for drinks, or a prize

ex.en: There is a cup of tea on the desk.
ex.zh: 桌上有一杯茶。

ex.en: Winning a cup brings a town one happy evening, not a clinic or a bus.
ex.zh: 赢得奖杯给城镇带来一个快乐的晚上，而不是诊所或公交。

tip: a cup of 后接不可数名词。

senses.en: a promise, or the time you give to something

ex.en: The club needs a commitment to lock the door.
ex.zh: 社团需要有人承诺锁门。

ex.en: A commitment to the late bus should be written, not only spoken.
ex.zh: 对晚班车的承诺应当写下来，而不只是说一说。

tip: commitment 可数也可不可数。

senses.en: a moving picture, or thin material for cameras
to record moving pictures

ex.en: We watched a short film about the town.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部关于这个城镇的短片。

ex.en: A film about a flood can move people, but it does not repair the broken drain.
ex.zh: 一部关于洪水的电影可以打动人，但修不好破损的排水管。

tip: 英式常用 film，美式常用 movie。

senses.en: a dirty or untidy state

ex.en: The lab was a mess after the experiment.
ex.zh: 实验之后实验室一片凌乱。

ex.en: A mess in the hallway is a safety problem if bags block the door.
ex.zh: 如果包堵住了门，走廊里的凌乱就是安全问题。

tip: mess 可数。make a mess of 表示把……搞糟。

senses.en: a standard, height, or rank

ex.en: Her reading level has improved this term.
ex.zh: 她的阅读水平这学期提高了。

ex.en: Noise levels beside a main road can be high enough to disturb an open classroom window.
ex.zh: 主干道旁的噪音水平可以高到打扰开着窗的教室。

col: at a high level｜在高水平
tip: level 作形容词是“平坦的”。

senses.en: later, after an event

ex.en: We cleaned the lab afterwards.
ex.zh: 后来我们打扫了实验室。

ex.en: Afterwards the notice was corrected, but the class had already left.
ex.zh: 后来通知改了，班级却已经走了。

tip: afterwards 是副词。美式也作 afterward。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: the United States, or the American continents

ex.en: She hopes to visit America after university.
ex.zh: 她希望大学毕业后去美国看看。

ex.en: News from America reaches a classroom in minutes, but students still need to ask who wrote it.
ex.zh: 来自美国的新闻几分钟就能进课堂，但学生仍要问是谁写的。

tip: 国家名 America 前通常不加 the；the United States 要加 the。

senses.en: a smaller road off a main one

ex.en: We took a side road to avoid the traffic.
ex.zh: 我们走了一条支路以避开车流。

ex.en: A side road without a pavement still forces children into the same space as cars.
ex.zh: 没有人行道的支路，仍然把孩子推进和汽车相同的空间。

tip: side road 是主路旁边的小路，不要和 roadside（路边）混用。

senses.en: with nothing inside
to remove everything from something

ex.en: The bottle was empty.
ex.zh: 瓶子是空的。

ex.en: An empty seat on the late bus is useless if the stop has no light.
ex.zh: 如果车站没有灯，晚班车上的空座也没用。

tip: empty 作动词是倒空。

senses.en: to connect in the mind, or to spend time with
a partner or colleague

ex.en: Students associate the bell with the end of class.
ex.zh: 学生把铃声和下课联系在一起。

ex.en: Do not associate one late bus with every driver.
ex.zh: 不要把一趟晚班车和每一位司机联系在一起。

col: associate A with B｜把 A 与 B 联系起来
tip: association 已在本库。associate 作名词是同事，重音常在后。

senses.en: in addition, or different

ex.en: Would anyone else like to speak?
ex.zh: 还有别人想发言吗？

ex.en: If the bus is full, students have little else to do but wait in the rain.
ex.zh: 如果公交满了，学生几乎只能在雨里等。

tip: else 放在疑问词或不定代词后面：what else、someone else。

senses.en: to get money or respect by work

ex.en: She earns her bus fare at the weekend.
ex.zh: 她周末挣公交费。

ex.en: A city earns trust when the flood plan is practised, not only printed.
ex.zh: 当防汛方案被演练而不只是被印刷时，城市才赢得信任。

tip: earn 后接钱、生活或尊重。

senses.en: an unusual and exciting experience

ex.en: The trip was an adventure, and everyone came back.
ex.zh: 这次出行是一次奇遇，而且每个人都回来了。

ex.en: An adventure on the river still needs life jackets.
ex.zh: 河上的冒险仍然需要救生衣。

tip: adventure 可数。

senses.en: a strip worn around the waist, or a region

ex.en: The belt on the bag is loose.
ex.zh: 包上的带子松了。

ex.en: A green belt around the town keeps a path for walking.
ex.zh: 城镇周围的绿化带留出一条步行的路。

tip: seat belt 是安全带。

senses.en: a hard building material
definite and real, not only an idea

ex.en: The path is concrete, not soil.
ex.zh: 这条路是混凝土的，不是土的。

ex.en: A concrete plan names who locks the door.
ex.zh: 一个具体的计划会写明谁锁门。

tip: concrete 作形容词是具体的，和抽象相对。

senses.en: the highest part or rank
highest in position or degree

ex.en: My name is at the top of the list.
ex.zh: 我的名字在名单最上面。

ex.en: Standing at the top of a test list does not show whether a student can work with other people.
ex.zh: 站在成绩榜顶端，并不能说明一个学生能否与他人合作。

tip: top 作形容词表示“顶级的”：top speed。

senses.en: a formal meeting of questions
to ask someone questions in a formal meeting

ex.en: She has an interview at the library on Friday.
ex.zh: 她周五在图书馆有一场面试。

ex.en: An interview that only rewards confidence can miss a quiet student who knows the work.
ex.zh: 只奖励自信的面试，可能错过一个懂业务但安静的学生。

tip: interview 可作名词或动词。采访和面试是同一个词。

senses.en: almost the same

ex.en: The two maps are similar, but not the same.
ex.zh: 两张地图相似，但并不相同。

ex.en: Similar test scores can hide very different chances to study at home.
ex.zh: 相似的考分可能掩盖在家学习机会的巨大差别。

tip: similar to 后接比较对象，不用 with。

senses.en: all of something

ex.en: I spent the whole morning in the lab.
ex.zh: 我整个上午都在实验室。

ex.en: Protecting a whole river means caring for farms and factories, not only the city section.
ex.zh: 保护整条河意味着要管农场和工厂，而不只是城区那一段。

tip: whole 前面通常有 the 或物主代词：the whole day。

senses.en: an idea or the act of thinking
past form of think

ex.en: That is a thoughtful question.
ex.zh: 那是一个有想法的问题。

ex.en: A single thoughtless comment online can follow a student longer than the mistake that caused it.
ex.zh: 网上一句欠考虑的话，可能比引发它的那个错误跟随学生更久。

tip: thought 也是 think 的过去式和过去分词。

senses.en: to respect or look up to someone
To look at something with pleasure because it is attractive

ex.en: I admire her courage in difficult times.
ex.zh: 我钦佩她在困难时期的勇气。

ex.en: People often admire successful athletes for their determination, but consistent training is equally important.
ex.zh: 人们常因成功运动员的毅力而钦佩他们，但坚持训练同样重要。

col: admire someone for something｜因某事钦佩某人
tip: admire sb for sth：因某事钦佩某人。

senses.en: a state or requirement
A requirement, or circumstances affecting life or activity
A medical problem affecting someone's health

ex.en: The road is in poor condition.
ex.zh: 这条路状况很差。

ex.en: Improving working conditions can increase employee satisfaction and reduce the number of people leaving their jobs.
ex.zh: 改善工作条件可以提高员工满意度，并减少离职人数。

tip: 表状态通常不可数；表工作、生活环境常用复数。

senses.en: of a colour between red and blue
the colour purple

ex.en: The jacket is purple.
ex.zh: 夹克是紫色的。

ex.en: A purple poster is not a plan if the words are too small.
ex.zh: 如果字太小，紫色海报也不是方案。

tip: purple 也可作名词。

senses.en: a container for liquids, usually glass or plastic

ex.en: Please return the bottle to the bin.
ex.zh: 请把瓶子放回桶里。

ex.en: A labelled bottle in the lab is safer than a faster experiment.
ex.zh: 实验室里贴了标签的瓶子，比做得更快的实验更安全。

tip: bottle 可数。作动词是把……装瓶。

senses.en: not joined, or different
to divide or keep apart

ex.en: Keep the broken glass in a separate box.
ex.zh: 把碎玻璃放在单独的盒子里。

ex.en: Separate queues for the bus stop a crowd from pushing the smallest students aside.
ex.zh: 分开排队能避免人群把最小的学生挤到一边。

tip: 形容词常读 /ˈsepərət/，动词“分开”常读 /ˈsepəreɪt/。

senses.en: not mixed with anything else

ex.en: The lab uses pure water.
ex.zh: 实验室用纯净水。

ex.en: Pure luck does not explain a result that the same class can repeat.
ex.zh: 同一个班能重复的结果，不能只用纯运气解释。

tip: purely 表示完全地、仅仅。pure 不要和 poor 混淆。

senses.en: how heavy something is

ex.en: The bag is light in weight.
ex.zh: 这个包重量很轻。

ex.en: The weight of a full schoolbag is a daily load, especially for younger children on a long walk.
ex.zh: 装满的书包的重量是每天的负担，尤其对走远路的年幼孩子。

tip: weight 是名词；weigh 是动词“称重”。

senses.en: to hit, to attack suddenly, or to stop work in protest

ex.en: The bell will strike at eight.
ex.zh: 钟将在八点敲响。

ex.en: When bus drivers strike, the school needs a written way for students to get home.
ex.zh: 公交司机罢工时，学校需要一份书面办法让学生回家。

tip: strike 的过去式和过去分词一般是 struck。罢工用 go on strike。本条不写任何伤害方法。

senses.en: to take something that is not yours

ex.en: He did not steal the book; it was a loan.
ex.zh: 他没有偷书，那是借的。

ex.en: A school should not call a hungry child a thief for taking bread.
ex.zh: 学校不应当因为一个饥饿的孩子拿了面包就把他叫做小偷。

tip: steal 的过去式是 stole，过去分词是 stolen。本条不写偷窃方法。

senses.en: to move around, or to become
a chance to do something, or a change of direction

ex.en: Turn left at the bookshop.
ex.zh: 在书店处向左转。

ex.en: Parks can turn a hot street into a place where people are willing to walk.
ex.zh: 公园能把一条炎热的街道变成人们愿意步行的地方。

tip: turn 加形容词表示变化：turn green。开灯用 turn on，不是 open the light。

senses.en: one part or one item

ex.en: May I have a piece of paper?
ex.zh: 我可以要一张纸吗？

ex.en: A piece of false news can travel farther than the correction that follows it.
ex.zh: 一条假消息可以比随后的更正传得更远。

tip: 不可数名词要说数量时常用 a piece of。

senses.en: what a person thinks

ex.en: In my opinion, the second answer is better.
ex.zh: 在我看来，第二个答案更好。

ex.en: Public opinion changes when people see the flooded street, not only the plan.
ex.zh: 当人们看到积水的街道而不只是方案时，舆论会改变。

tip: opinion 是可数名词。

senses.en: of a pale red colour
a pale red colour

ex.en: The pink notice is the new one.
ex.zh: 粉红色的通知是新的。

ex.en: Pink paper does not make a wrong time correct.
ex.zh: 粉纸不能把写错的时间变成对的。

tip: pink 也可作名词。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: a period of teaching, or something learned from experience

ex.en: The next lesson is history.
ex.zh: 下一节是历史。

ex.en: The lesson of the late bus is to write the return time on the same sheet.
ex.zh: 晚班车的教训是把返回时间写在同一张纸上。

col: a lesson in｜一节……课；一个教训
teach sb a lesson｜给某人一个教训
tip: lesson 可数。teach somebody a lesson 有时语气是教训某人。

senses.en: on the outside

ex.en: The outer door is locked.
ex.zh: 外面那扇门锁了。

ex.en: The outer wall needs a light at the crossing.
ex.zh: 外墙在路口需要一盏灯。

tip: outer 只作定语，放在名词前。

senses.en: allowed by law
Allowed by the law

ex.en: Is this action legal?
ex.zh: 这个行为合法吗？

ex.en: Access to affordable legal services is essential for ensuring that disadvantaged citizens can defend their rights.
ex.zh: 让人们获得负担得起的法律服务，对保障弱势公民维护自身权利至关重要。

tip: legal可指“法律相关的”，不一定指“合法的”。

senses.en: a piece of land for flowers or vegetables

ex.en: The class grows tomatoes in the garden.
ex.zh: 班级在园子里种西红柿。

ex.en: A school garden teaches seasons only if someone is there to water it in August.
ex.zh: 学校的园子只有在八月仍有人浇水时，才能教给学生季节。

tip: garden 可指花园、菜园或果园。

senses.en: a person receiving medical care
able to wait without getting angry

ex.en: The patient waited in the school clinic.
ex.zh: 病人在校医务室等候。

ex.en: A patient teacher gives a second explanation without making the class feel small.
ex.zh: 有耐心的老师会再讲一遍，而不让全班觉得难堪。

tip: patient 作名词是病人，作形容词是耐心的。

senses.en: a machine that can do tasks by itself

ex.en: The robot in the lab is switched off.
ex.zh: 实验室里的机器人关着。

ex.en: A robot that answers the phone is not a person who can change the bus time.
ex.zh: 接电话的机器人不是一个能改公交时间的人。

tip: robot 可数。

senses.en: complete disorder

ex.en: The hall was chaos when the bell failed.
ex.zh: 铃坏了的时候礼堂一片混乱。

ex.en: Chaos at the gate is what you get when nobody writes the bus time.
ex.zh: 没人写公交时间时，门口就会乱。

tip: chaos 通常不可数。

senses.en: a person who leads

ex.en: The team leader explained the plan.
ex.zh: 队长解释了计划。

ex.en: A good leader asks who will be harmed before a new road is approved.
ex.zh: 好的领导者在批准新路之前会问谁将受到伤害。

tip: leader 是人；leadership 是领导能力。

senses.en: happy about something

ex.en: The teacher was pleased with the map.
ex.zh: 老师对这张地图感到高兴。

ex.en: Parents are pleased when a late bus is explained.
ex.zh: 晚班车得到解释时，家长会高兴。

tip: pleased 形容人。pleasing 形容事物。pleasure 已在本库。

senses.en: the point where something begins

ex.en: The origin of the word is on the last line.
ex.zh: 这个词的来源在最后一行。

ex.en: The origin of a flood is not only the rain; it is also the blocked drain.
ex.zh: 洪水的起因不只是雨，也包括堵住的排水口。

tip: origin 可数。original 是形容词“原来的；独创的”。

senses.en: most important

ex.en: The main entrance is on the left.
ex.zh: 正门在左边。

ex.en: The main reason for late arrivals is the bus, not a lack of interest in the first lesson.
ex.zh: 迟到的主要原因是公交，不是对第一节课缺乏兴趣。

tip: main 没有比较级。mainly 是副词“主要地”。

senses.en: a white substance used to flavour food

ex.en: There is too much salt in the soup.
ex.zh: 这汤盐太多了。

ex.en: Salt on an icy step helps, and it also damages the plants beside it.
ex.zh: 结冰台阶上的盐有帮助，也会伤害旁边的植物。

tip: salt 通常不可数。take something with a pinch of salt 表示不完全相信。

senses.en: more than two but not many

ex.en: Several students stayed to tidy the lab.
ex.zh: 几个学生留下来收拾实验室。

ex.en: Several small parks can serve a neighbourhood better than one large park that is hard to reach.
ex.zh: 几个小公园服务一个社区，可能好过一座很难到达的大公园。

tip: several 后接可数名词复数。

senses.en: something valuable that you give up
to give something up

ex.en: Sleep should not be the sacrifice before an exam.
ex.zh: 考前不应当牺牲睡眠。

ex.en: A sacrifice of one lunch break can keep the library open.
ex.zh: 牺牲一次午休，可以让图书馆继续开着。

tip: sacrifice 作动词是牺牲。本条不写伤害自己或他人的做法。

senses.en: up to a particular time
up to the time when

ex.en: The shop is open until nine.
ex.zh: 商店营业到九点。

ex.en: A library that stays open until the last bus can serve students who cannot study at home.
ex.zh: 开到末班车的图书馆，可以服务那些无法在家学习的学生。

tip: until 可作介词或连词。not...until 表示直到……才。

senses.en: with no sound, or not speaking

ex.en: The hall was silent after the question.
ex.zh: 问题之后礼堂一片寂静。

ex.en: A silent student is not the same as a student who agrees.
ex.zh: 沉默的学生不等于同意的学生。

tip: 名词 silence 已在本库。silent 是形容词。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: every one separately

ex.en: Each student has a different seat number.
ex.zh: 每个学生的座位号都不一样。

ex.en: Each small shop that closes on a high street takes away a place where neighbours used to talk.
ex.zh: 商业街上每关掉一家小店，就少了一个邻居们曾经聊天的地方。

tip: each of 加复数名词时，谓语常用单数。

senses.en: a person who buys goods or services

ex.en: The customer asked for a receipt.
ex.zh: 顾客要了收据。

ex.en: A school shop should treat a student as a customer and still say no to a harmful product.
ex.zh: 学校小卖部应当把学生当顾客，同时仍然拒绝有害的商品。

tip: customer 可数。买东西的人。client 更常指服务的委托人。

senses.zh: 以某种方式；不知怎么地
senses.en: in a way that is not known

ex.en: We somehow caught the last bus.
ex.zh: 我们不知怎么赶上了末班车。

ex.en: A plan that says somehow is not a plan; write the step.
ex.zh: 只说“想办法”的方案不是方案，把步骤写出来。

tip: somehow 是副词。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: an emotion or a physical sense

ex.en: I had a feeling that the answer was wrong.
ex.zh: 我有一种感觉，这个答案是错的。

ex.en: A feeling of safety on the walk home depends on lights, not only on a low crime number.
ex.zh: 回家路上的安全感取决于灯光，而不只是一个很低的犯罪数字。

tip: feeling 是可数名词。

senses.en: ordinary, happening each day

ex.en: These are everyday words, not exam tricks.
ex.zh: 这些是日常用词，不是考试陷阱。

ex.en: Everyday help, such as holding a door, matters as much as a speech.
ex.zh: 扶门这样的日常帮助，和一篇讲话一样重要。

tip: everyday 是一个词，作形容词。every day 分开写是“每天”。表里这一行的音标是 everybody，本库不用。

senses.en: to bring things together

ex.en: Collect the forms before you leave.
ex.zh: 离开前把表收齐。

ex.en: Cities collect the same plastic for years and still need a bin that is emptied.
ex.zh: 城市多年收集同一种塑料，仍然需要一个会被清空的桶。

tip: collection 已在本库。

senses.en: a power that seems impossible, or a wonderful quality
having a mysterious or wonderful power

ex.en: The story uses magic to solve the problem.
ex.zh: 这个故事用魔法解决问题。

ex.en: There is no magic timetable that gives every child a quiet desk at home.
ex.zh: 没有一种神奇课表能让每个孩子家里都有一张安静的书桌。

col: as if by magic｜像变魔术一样
tip: magic 也可作形容词：a magic trick。

senses.en: a person's mood or courage, or a non-physical being

ex.en: The team spirit was better after the talk.
ex.zh: 谈话之后团队精神更好了。

ex.en: School spirit is real when students help a classmate, not only when they shout at a match.
ex.zh: 当学生帮助同学，而不只是在比赛中呐喊时，学校精神才是真的。

tip: spirit 表示精神时常不可数。in high spirits 表示兴高采烈。

senses.en: a plan, or the way things are organized

ex.en: The arrangement is on the sheet.
ex.zh: 安排写在这张纸上。

ex.en: An arrangement for the late bus should name who locks the gate.
ex.zh: 晚班车的安排应当写明谁锁门。

tip: 动词 arrange 已在本库。

senses.en: a subject of speech or writing

ex.en: The topic of the essay is water.
ex.zh: 作文题目是水。

ex.en: A topic that ignores the bus will not interest the students who miss it.
ex.zh: 无视公交的题目，不会让那些赶不上车的学生感兴趣。

tip: topic 可数。

senses.en: very unpleasant or frightening

ex.en: The smell from the bin was horrible.
ex.zh: 桶里的气味很糟。

ex.en: A horrible score on one quiz is information, not the end of a student.
ex.zh: 一次小测的糟糕分数是信息，不是一个学生的终点。

tip: horrible 程度很强。不要用来嘲笑同学。

senses.en: a particular way of doing something

ex.en: The technique is explained on the board.
ex.zh: 技巧写在黑板上。

ex.en: A technique for checking a source is more useful than a longer essay with none.
ex.zh: 核对来源的方法，比一篇更长却没有来源的文章更有用。

tip: technique 可数。technical 已在本库。表里这一行的音标是 technical，本库不用。

senses.en: a large amount of money or resources

ex.en: The town wealth is not only its shops.
ex.zh: 这座城镇的财富不只是它的商店。

ex.en: Wealth that never reaches the clinic is not shared.
ex.zh: 到不了诊所的财富，就不是被分享的。

tip: wealth 通常不可数。a wealth of 表示大量。

senses.en: more than usual

ex.en: I need extra time to check the answers.
ex.zh: 我需要额外的时间检查答案。

ex.en: Extra lanes do not cut traffic if they only invite more cars.
ex.zh: 如果额外的车道只是招来更多汽车，它们并不能减少交通。

tip: extra 可作形容词或名词。

senses.en: to put something down

ex.en: Lay the map on the desk.
ex.zh: 把地图放在桌上。

ex.en: Workers lay a new path before the rainy season, not after the first flood.
ex.zh: 工人在雨季之前铺新路，而不是等第一次洪水之后。

tip: lay 是及物动词，过去式和过去分词是 laid。lie（躺）的过去式才是 lay。lie 已在本库。

senses.en: to think of someone or something in a particular way
respect, or good wishes

ex.en: We regard the library as a public room.
ex.zh: 我们把图书馆看作公共房间。

ex.en: Do not regard a low score as the whole student.
ex.zh: 不要把一个低分看成整个学生。

tip: regard 作名词常用复数 regards，表示问候。

senses.en: a wash in a bathtub, or the tub itself

ex.en: The bath is at the end of the hall.
ex.zh: 浴缸在走廊尽头。

ex.en: A hot bath is not a plan for a school; a working shower is.
ex.zh: 热水澡不是学校的方案；能用的淋浴才是。

tip: 英式 have a bath 是盆浴。美式更常说 take a bath。bathroom 已在本库。

senses.en: unhappy

ex.en: She felt sad after the team lost.
ex.zh: 队伍输了之后她很难过。

ex.en: A sad ending in a film can still teach a class how a choice affects other people.
ex.zh: 电影里悲伤的结局，仍然可以教一个班：一个选择如何影响别人。

tip: sad 的名词是 sadness。不要说 a sad。

senses.en: in opposition to, or touching

ex.en: Our team will play against Class Three.
ex.zh: 我们队将和三班比赛。

ex.en: Laws against litter only work when bins are near and people see that the rules apply to everyone.
ex.zh: 禁止乱扔垃圾的法律，只有在附近有垃圾桶、而且人人都受约束时才有效。

tip: against 是介词，后面接名词、代词或 doing。

senses.en: a very short time

ex.en: Wait a moment, please.
ex.zh: 请稍等。

ex.en: The moment a rumour is shared, it is harder to replace it with a correction.
ex.zh: 谣言一经转发，就更难用更正来替换它。

tip: the moment 可引导时间从句，相当于 as soon as。

senses.en: strength, control, or electricity
to supply energy to a machine

ex.en: The storm cut the power for two hours.
ex.zh: 暴风雨导致停电两小时。

ex.en: The power to change a bus route should sit with people who actually ride it, not only with planners.
ex.zh: 更改公交线路的权力，应该掌握在真正乘坐它的人手里，而不只是规划者。

tip: power 表示电力时不可数。作动词是“驱动”或“供电”。

senses.en: to get something

ex.en: You can obtain the form at the office.
ex.zh: 你可以在办公室拿到表格。

ex.en: Students obtain a seat on the late bus by arriving, not by a poster.
ex.zh: 学生得到晚班车的座位是靠来到，不是靠一张海报。

tip: obtain 比 get 正式。

senses.en: extremely good

ex.en: Her map was outstanding.
ex.zh: 她的地图非常出色。

ex.en: An outstanding score does not replace the student who kept the lab tidy.
ex.zh: 出色的分数代替不了那个让实验室保持整洁的学生。

tip: outstanding 也可表示未支付的：outstanding fees。

senses.en: related to race

ex.en: Racial equality is the principle on the form.
ex.zh: 种族平等是表格上的原则。

ex.en: A racial joke is not a joke the class should keep.
ex.zh: 种族笑话不是班级该保留的笑话。

tip: race 已在本库。说话时要尊重。

senses.en: a large container, or a military vehicle

ex.en: The water tank is on the roof.
ex.zh: 水箱在屋顶上。

ex.en: A history photo of a tank should stay a photo, not a set of instructions.
ex.zh: 历史照片里的坦克应当只是照片，而不是一套说明。

tip: tank 可指容器或坦克。本条不写军事操作。

senses.en: of the west

ex.en: We compared a western folk story with a Chinese one.
ex.zh: 我们把一个西方民间故事和中国故事做了比较。

ex.en: Western visitors may admire an old street and still miss the rents that local families pay.
ex.zh: 西方游客可能欣赏一条老街，却仍然看不到本地家庭支付的房租。

tip: western 是形容词，通常不大写，除非是专名的一部分。

senses.en: an area with a particular use or feature

ex.en: This street is a quiet zone.
ex.zh: 这条街是安静区域。

ex.en: A school zone with a lower speed limit only works if drivers can see the sign.
ex.zh: 学校区域的低速限制只有在司机看得见标志时才有效。

tip: zone 强调按用途或特征划分的区域。表里这一行的音标是 zoo，本库不用。

senses.en: a strong metal, or a tool for smoothing clothes
to smooth clothes with an iron

ex.en: The gate is iron and heavy.
ex.zh: 这扇门是铁的，很重。

ex.en: An iron in a dormitory needs a clear rule, or a small burn becomes a fire.
ex.zh: 宿舍里的熨斗需要明确规定，否则一小块烫痕会变成火灾。

tip: iron 作动词是熨烫。化学符号相关的“铁”不可数。

senses.en: a group effort for change, or the act of moving

ex.en: The movement to save the river started at school.
ex.zh: 拯救这条河的运动从学校开始。

ex.en: Free movement to a clinic matters when the only road floods.
ex.zh: 当唯一的路积水时，能自由前往诊所就很重要。

tip: movement 可指社会运动，也可指动作。

senses.en: separated by distance or into pieces

ex.en: The two labs are only a corridor apart.
ex.zh: 两间实验室只隔一条走廊。

ex.en: Apart from the price, the later bus is the one that working students can actually catch.
ex.zh: 除了价格，晚一班的公交才是打工的学生真正赶得上的。

tip: apart from 表示除……之外。tell apart 表示区分。

senses.en: to one side

ex.en: She stepped aside to let the class pass.
ex.zh: 她站到一边让班级过去。

ex.en: Set aside ten minutes, or the notice will be written in a hurry.
ex.zh: 留出十分钟，否则通知会写得很匆忙。

tip: aside from 与 besides 相近。put aside 是把东西放到一边。

senses.en: a person with special skill
Having or showing great knowledge or skill.

ex.en: Ask an expert for advice.
ex.zh: 向专家征求建议。

ex.en: Schools should seek expert advice before introducing new technology into classrooms to support student learning.
ex.zh: 学校在将新技术引入课堂以辅助学生学习之前，应征求专家意见。

col: an expert on｜某方面的专家
tip: expert on/in表示某领域的专家。

senses.en: something given, or a natural ability

ex.en: The book was a gift from her uncle.
ex.zh: 这本书是她叔叔送的礼物。

ex.en: A gift for music still needs practice if the student wants a place in the band.
ex.zh: 如果学生想在乐队里有位置，音乐天赋仍然需要练习。

tip: gift 可指礼物，也可指天赋。a gift for doing 表示有做某事的天分。

senses.en: a special event for a happy occasion

ex.en: The celebration is on Friday.
ex.zh: 庆祝活动在周五。

ex.en: A celebration that starts after the last bus has already chosen who can come.
ex.zh: 在末班车之后才开始的庆祝，其实已经选定了谁能来。

tip: 动词 celebrate 已在本库。

senses.en: one more, or a different one

ex.en: May I ask another question?
ex.zh: 我可以再问一个问题吗？

ex.en: Another heatwave will test whether the city's new shelters are more than a promise on paper.
ex.zh: 又一轮热浪将检验这座城市的新避暑点是否不只是纸上的承诺。

tip: another 后接单数名词；“另外两个”可以说 another two days。

senses.en: a structure with a roof and walls

ex.en: The new building has a lift.
ex.zh: 新楼有电梯。

ex.en: An empty building in the town centre is a wasted chance to house a clinic or a library.
ex.zh: 镇中心的空楼是浪费，本可以用来做诊所或图书馆。

tip: building 是名词；build 是动词，过去式 built。

senses.en: possibly

ex.en: Perhaps we can finish before lunch.
ex.zh: 也许我们能在午饭前做完。

ex.en: Perhaps a later school start would help, but only if the buses change too.
ex.zh: 也许推迟上学时间会有帮助，但只有公交也改才行。

tip: perhaps 比 maybe 稍正式，意思接近。

senses.en: a drawing that shows information

ex.en: The chart shows the bus times.
ex.zh: 图表显示公交时间。

ex.en: A chart without a source is only a picture.
ex.zh: 没有来源的图表只是一张图。

tip: chart 可数。也可作动词“绘制”。

senses.en: a natural ability

ex.en: She has a talent for drawing maps.
ex.zh: 她有画地图的天赋。

ex.en: A talent for music still needs a room and an instrument the student can borrow.
ex.zh: 音乐天赋仍然需要一间房和一件学生能借到的乐器。

tip: talent 可数也可不可数。have a talent for doing。
